title: Bajra puri
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Bajray ka atta (Millet flour) sifted 1 & ½ Cups
Lal mirch (Red chili) powder 1 tsp or to taste
Methi (Fresh fenugreek leaves) chopped ½ Cup
Pani (Water) ½ Cup or as required

steps.instruction: In a bowl,mash boiled potatoes with the help of the masher.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein boiled aloo masher ki madad sa ache tarhan mash ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add millet flour,wheat flour,salt,cumin seeds,red chili powder,baking soda,fresh fenugreek leaves, yogurt and mix well until crumbled.
steps.romanUrdu: Bajray ka atta,atta namak,zeera,lal mirch powder,baking soda,methi aur dahi dal ker ache tarhan crumbled hunay tak mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and knead until soft dough is formed (approx. 5-6 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker naram dough tayyar ker lein (approx. 5-6 minutes).

steps.instruction: Take a small dough,make a ball and sprinkle dry wheat flour and roll out with the help of rolling pin (makes 9-10).Don’t rest the dough.
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein aur ball bana lein aur atta chirak ker rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein (makes 9-10). Dough ko rest nahi dena hai.

steps.instruction: In wok,heat cooking oil and fry puri on medium low flame until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil garam karein aur puri ko darmiyani halki ancch per golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

ogDescription: Bajra Puri recipe for you today. So make it, share it, dip it and enjoy it. #HappyCookingToYou
